tools.name: unity_gameobject
tools.description:
Scene GameObjects and their components: find/create/delete, transform, parent, active, tag, layer, add/remove/read/write components and serialized fields.
Actions:
- add_component: Add a component (by type name) to a GameObject. [requires target,type]
- create_gameobject: Create an empty GameObject or a built-in primitive (cube/sphere/capsule/cylinder/plane/quad) in the active scene.
- create_gameobjects: Batch-create N empty GameObjects or primitives in one call. Optional positions/rotations/scales are arrays of [x,y,z] (length must equal count). Returns the created identities.
- delete_gameobject: Delete a GameObject from the scene (reversible via Undo). [requires target]
- find_gameobjects: Find GameObjects in loaded scenes by name, tag, component type, and/or hierarchy path (filters are combined). Returns structured identities.
- get_component_properties: Get a component's serialized properties as a JSON map. Address the component by handle, or by GameObject handle + type. [requires target]
- get_serialized_fields: Read serialized fields of a component/asset. Returns each top-level field's name, type and value (object references are returned as re-usable handles). Pass 'field' to read a single SerializedProperty path. Pass format='value' to return just the value(s) — a token-efficient read for scalars. [requires target]
- remove_component: Remove a component from a GameObject. Provide either a component handle (target) or a GameObject handle (target) plus a type name. [requires target]
- rename_gameobject: Rename a GameObject. [requires target,name]
- set_active: Set a GameObject's active self-state (activeSelf). [requires target,active]
- set_component_properties: Set serialized properties on a component (one Undo step). 'properties' maps property name -> value; object references accept an ObjectRef handle. [requires target,properties]
- set_layer: Set a GameObject's layer by name or numeric index (0-31). [requires target,layer]
- set_parent: Reparent a GameObject under a new parent, or detach it to scene root when no parent is given. [requires target]
- set_serialized_field: Set a serialized field on a component/asset. Supports primitives, enums, Vector/Color/Rect/Bounds, object references (value = an ObjectRef: asset by guid/fileId/path or scene object by instanceId/hierarchyPath), and array elements via 'name.Array.data[i]' (or 'name.Array.size' to resize). [requires target,field,value]
- set_tag: Set a GameObject's tag (the tag must already exist in the project). [requires target,tag]
- set_transform: Set a GameObject's local position/rotation(euler)/scale. Omitted channels are left unchanged. [requires target]

count.description: How many GameObjects to create. Default 1.

positions.description: Local positions, one [x,y,z] per object. Length must equal count when supplied.

rotations.description: Local Euler rotations (degrees), one [x,y,z] per object. Length must equal count when supplied.

scales.description: Local scales, one [x,y,z] per object. Length must equal count when supplied.

format.description: Output shape. Omit (default) for a full descriptor per field {name,path,propertyType,isArray,arrayLength,value}; 'value' returns just the value(s): the raw value for a single 'field', or a {name: value} map for all fields.

properties.description: Map of serialized property name to value. Vectors/colors are arrays; object refs are handle objects.

world_position_stays.description: Keep the object's world position when reparenting. Default true.

value.description: JSON value to assign. For object references pass an ObjectRef object (or null to clear). For enums pass the value name.

rotation.description: Local rotation as Euler angles [x,y,z] in degrees.

tools.name: unity_scene
tools.description:
Scenes: create/open/save, list open scenes, active scene, scene hierarchy.
Actions:
- create_scene: Create a new scene and save it to the given path under the authoring root. [requires path]
- get_scene_hierarchy: Return the GameObject tree of an open scene (or the active scene). Each node carries instanceId + hierarchyPath usable by GameObject commands.
- list_open_scenes: List all currently open scenes with their load/active/dirty state.
- open_scene: Open an existing scene from the given path. [requires path]
- save_all: Save all open scenes that have unsaved changes.
- save_scene: Save an open scene. Saves the active scene when no path is given.
- set_active_scene: Set which open scene is the active scene (new objects are created in the active scene). [requires path]

template.description: Initial contents: 'empty' (default) for a blank scene, or 'default' to seed a Main Camera + Directional Light matching Unity's built-in 3D template.

tools.name: unity_asset
tools.description:
Project assets and files: find/create/move/copy/rename/delete, folders, import settings, text files, materials and shaders.
Actions:
- copy_asset: Copy an asset to a new path under the authoring root. The copy gets a fresh GUID. [requires asset,destination]
- create_asset: Create a new ScriptableObject (or other UnityEngine.Object) asset of the given type at a path under the authoring root. [requires path,type]
- create_folder: Create a folder under the authoring root (creates intermediate folders). [requires path]
- delete_asset: Delete an asset from the project. Destructive: requires confirm=true. [requires asset]
- find_assets: Find assets by type and/or name and/or label, returning their path, GUID and type. At least one filter is required.
- get_import_settings: Read an asset's import settings, structured by importer type (texture/model/audio), including the default-platform fields and (for textures/audio) one platform override block. [requires asset]
- get_material_properties: Read a material's shader, render queue, enabled keywords, and all shader properties with their current values (Color as [r,g,b,a], Vector as [x,y,z,w], Texture as an object reference). [requires material]
- get_shader_properties: Introspect a shader's declared property list (name, description, type Color|Vector|Float|Range|TexEnv|Int, range, textureDimension, flags). Provide 'shader' (by name) OR 'material' (read the shader off that material).
- import_asset: Import an external file (e.g. a texture, model, audio clip) into the project by copying it to a path under the authoring root, then importing it. [requires source,path]
- list_shaders: Discover available shaders so an agent can pick a valid name for set_material_properties / create_asset. Returns [{ name, assetPath|null, isBuiltin, isSupported }].
- move_asset: Move (or rename via a new path) an asset to a new location under the authoring root. Preserves the asset's GUID. [requires asset,destination]
- read_text_file: Read a UTF-8 text file under the authoring root and return its contents. [requires path]
- rename_asset: Rename an asset in place (keeps it in the same folder, keeps its GUID). [requires asset,new_name]
- set_import_settings: Set import settings on an asset's AssetImporter (default platform top-level properties, or a texture/audio per-platform override) and re-import it. [requires asset,settings]
- set_material_properties: Set shader properties on a material (Float/Range/Int=number; Color=[r,g,b,a] or "#RRGGBBAA" hex; Vector=[x,y,z,w]; Texture=an object reference or null to clear), optionally reassign the shader, set the render queue, and toggle keywords. Unknown names / type mismatches are reported in unknown[]. [requires material]
- write_text_file: Write UTF-8 text to a file under the authoring root, then import it. Overwriting an existing file requires confirm=true. [requires path,contents]

name.description: Name substring to filter by (AssetDatabase name filter).

label.description: Asset label to filter by (AssetDatabase 'l:' filter).

search_in.description: Folder to scope the search to, relative to the authoring root (default: the authoring root).

source.description: Absolute filesystem path to the external file to import.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the shader name (e.g. "URP", "Lit").

includeBuiltin.description: Include built-in/engine shaders (those with no project asset path). Default true.

max_bytes.description: Reject files larger than this many bytes (default 1048576 = 1 MiB) to avoid huge payloads.

new_name.description: New file name WITHOUT a folder path. The extension is preserved if omitted.

settings.description: JSON object of importer property/field names to values, e.g. {"isReadable": true, "textureType": "NormalMap"}. For platform != Default on a texture/audio importer, keys map onto the platform-settings struct (e.g. maxTextureSize, format, compressionFormat, quality, and overridden).

properties.description: JSON object of shader property name -> value. Names must include the leading underscore (e.g. _BaseColor). Float/Range/Int=number; Color=[r,g,b,a] or hex string; Vector=[x,y,z,w]; Texture=an object reference {guid/path} or null.

renderQueue.description: Explicit render queue, or -1 to inherit from the shader. Omit to leave unchanged.

contents.description: The full text content to write (replaces the file).

tools.name: unity_prefab
tools.description:
Prefabs: create, variants, instantiate, apply/revert overrides, unpack, edit prefab contents.
Actions:
- apply_prefab_overrides: Apply a prefab instance's overrides back to its source prefab asset. [requires instance]
- create_prefab: Save a GameObject as a prefab asset at a project path; the source becomes a connected instance. [requires source,path]
- create_prefab_variant: Create a prefab variant asset that inherits from a base prefab. [requires base,path]
- instantiate_prefab: Instantiate a prefab asset into a loaded scene and return the created instance. [requires prefab]
- revert_prefab_overrides: Revert a prefab instance's overrides so it matches its source prefab asset. [requires instance]
- save_prefab_contents: Open a prefab asset in an isolated prefab stage, apply a declarative edit, and save it back (nested-prefab safe). [requires prefab]
- unpack_prefab: Unpack a prefab instance into plain GameObjects (outermost level or completely). [requires instance]

source.description: Reference to the source GameObject to save as a prefab (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath).

base.description: Reference to the base prefab asset (path/guid/globalId).

scene_path.description: Optional path of a loaded scene to instantiate into; defaults to the active scene.

name.description: Optional name for the created instance; defaults to the prefab name.

rename_child.description: Optional child name (relative path under the root, e.g. 'Body/Head') to rename.

new_name.description: New name for the child identified by rename_child.

set_active_child.description: Optional child name (relative path under the root) whose active state to set.

active.description: Active state to apply when set_active_child is provided.

completely.description: If true, unpack all nested prefab levels (Completely); if false, only the outermost level (OutermostRoot).

tools.name: unity_animation
tools.description:
Animation clips/curves, AnimatorControllers (layers, parameters, states, transitions) and Timelines.
Actions:
- add_animator_layer: Add a layer to an AnimatorController. [requires controller,name]
- add_animator_parameter: Add a parameter (Float | Int | Bool | Trigger) to an AnimatorController. A duplicate name returns code 'duplicate_parameter'. [requires controller,name,type]
- add_animator_state: Add a state to a layer, optionally with a motion (AnimationClip or BlendTree) and as the layer default. A layer name with no match returns code 'layer_not_found'. [requires controller,name]
- add_animator_transition: Add a transition between two states (or from AnyState/Entry, to Exit) on a layer, with optional conditions. Validates that the states exist and each condition's parameter exists and its mode matches the parameter type. [requires controller,fromState,toState]
- add_timeline_clip: Add a clip to a named track on a TimelineAsset. For Animation tracks pass an AnimationClip asset; for Audio tracks an AudioClip. Requires the com.unity.timeline package. [requires timeline,track,start,duration]
- add_timeline_track: Add a track (Animation | Audio | Activation | Control | Playable | Signal | Marker) to a TimelineAsset, optionally nested under a parent group/track. Requires the com.unity.timeline package. [requires timeline,trackType]
- create_animation_clip: Create an empty .anim AnimationClip asset under the authoring root, with an optional frame rate and loop flag. [requires path]
- create_animator_controller: Create an .controller AnimatorController asset (with a default Base Layer) under the authoring root. [requires path]
- create_timeline: Create a .playable TimelineAsset under the authoring root (optional frame rate). Requires the com.unity.timeline package. [requires path]
- get_animation_clip: Read an AnimationClip's metadata and all float curve bindings (optionally with keyframes). [requires clip]
- get_animator_controller: Read an AnimatorController's full structure: parameters, layers, states (with motion / default), and transitions (with conditions). [requires controller]
- get_timeline: Read a TimelineAsset's structure: frame rate, duration, and its tracks with their clips. Requires the com.unity.timeline package. [requires timeline]
- remove_animation_curve: Remove a float curve binding from an AnimationClip (SetEditorCurve(clip, binding, null)). Destructive: requires confirm=true. [requires clip,type,property]
- set_animation_curve: Add or replace a single float curve binding on an AnimationClip (via AnimationUtility.SetEditorCurve). Replacing an existing binding overwrites it rather than duplicating. [requires clip,type,property,keys]

defaultValue.description: Default value for Float/Int/Bool (ignored for Trigger).

motion.description: Optional AnimationClip or BlendTree asset to assign as the state's motion.

isDefault.description: If true, set this state as the layer's default state.

position.description: Optional [x, y] node position in the graph (cosmetic).

fromState.description: Source state name, or the special "AnyState" / "Entry".

toState.description: Destination state name, or the special "Exit".

hasExitTime.description: If true, the transition uses exit time (default false).

exitTime.description: Normalized exit time (0..1) when hasExitTime is set.

hasFixedDuration.description: If true, duration is in seconds; otherwise normalized (default true).

asset.description: Source asset: for Animation tracks an AnimationClip; for Audio tracks an AudioClip. Required for those track types.

trackType.description: Track type: Animation | Audio | Activation | Control | Playable | Signal | Marker.

parentTrack.description: Optional name of an existing group/track to nest the new track under.

loop.description: If true, set the clip's loop-time flag in its AnimationClipSettings (default false).

includeKeys.description: If true, include each binding's keyframes (default false).

keys.description: Keyframes: [{ time, value, inTangent?, outTangent?, weightedMode?: "None"|"In"|"Out"|"Both" }]. Omitted tangents default to 0 (flat); this is NOT Unity's Auto tangent mode.

tools.name: unity_bake
tools.description:
Lighting, NavMesh and occlusion: settings, async bakes (poll *_status), cancel, clear.
Actions:
- bake_lighting: Trigger an async lightmap bake of the open scene(s) via Lightmapping.BakeAsync(). Returns immediately; poll lighting_bake_status until completed.
- bake_navmesh: Trigger an async legacy NavMesh bake of the open scene(s) via UnityEditor.AI.NavMeshBuilder. Returns immediately; poll navmesh_bake_status until completed.
- bake_navmesh_surfaces: Bake NavMeshSurface components (AI Navigation package). v1 stub: returns package_not_found when the package is absent.
- bake_occlusion_culling: Trigger an async occlusion-culling bake of the open scene(s) via StaticOcclusionCulling.GenerateInBackground(). Returns immediately; poll occlusion_bake_status until completed.
- cancel_lighting_bake: Cancel an in-progress lighting bake (Lightmapping.Cancel()).
- cancel_navmesh_bake: Cancel an in-progress NavMesh bake (NavMeshBuilder.Cancel()).
- cancel_occlusion_bake: Cancel an in-progress occlusion bake (StaticOcclusionCulling.Cancel()).
- clear_baked_lighting: Clear baked lightmap data for the open scene(s). Destructive: requires confirm=true.
- clear_navmesh: Clear the baked NavMesh for the open scene(s). Destructive: requires confirm=true.
- clear_occlusion_culling: Clear baked occlusion-culling data for the open scene(s). Destructive: requires confirm=true.
- get_lighting_settings: Read the active LightingSettings (lightmapper, bounces, resolution, directional mode, AO, etc.).
- get_navmesh_settings: Read the default agent's legacy NavMesh bake settings (agentRadius/Height/Slope/Climb, minRegionArea, voxelSize).
- lighting_bake_status: Get the status of the last lighting bake: idle | baking | completed.
- navmesh_bake_status: Get the status of the last NavMesh bake: idle | baking | completed.
- occlusion_bake_status: Get the status of the last occlusion bake: idle | baking | completed.
- set_lighting_settings: Apply a subset of lighting settings to the active LightingSettings. Returns { applied[], unknown[] }. [requires settings]
- set_navmesh_settings: Apply a subset of legacy NavMesh bake settings to the default agent. Returns { applied[], unknown[] }. [requires settings]

smallest_occluder.description: Smallest object that will occlude others (meters). Defaults to Unity's current value.

smallest_hole.description: Smallest gap geometry can have that the view can see through (meters). Defaults to Unity's current value.

backface_threshold.description: Backface threshold (1-100); lower trims more backfaces. Defaults to Unity's current value.

include_disk_cache.description: If true, also clear the GI disk cache (Lightmapping.ClearDiskCache()).

tools.name: unity_build
tools.description:
Player builds and build configuration: build (async, poll build_status), targets, profiles, build scene list.
Actions:
- add_scene_to_build: Add a scene to the Build Settings scene list (idempotent). Optionally enable it. [requires path]
- build: Trigger an async Player build and report the full BuildReport. Returns immediately (queued); poll build_status until status is 'completed'. DetailedBuildReport is included by default unless 'options' is supplied. Use dry_run to validate without building.
- build_status: Status of the current/most recent build: idle | queued | building | completed, with the full BuildReport (files, packedAssets, buildSteps, errors, warnings) once completed. Retained until the next build.
- get_build_settings: Read the current build configuration from EditorUserBuildSettings / EditorBuildSettings.
- list_build_profiles: List Build Profile assets in the project (Unity 6 only). Returns feature_unavailable on earlier versions.
- list_build_targets: List the known BuildTarget values with their group and whether build support is installed.
- remove_scene_from_build: Remove a scene from the Build Settings scene list (idempotent). [requires path]
- set_build_settings: Set mutable EditorUserBuildSettings fields. Does NOT manage scenes (use add_scene_to_build / remove_scene_from_build) or switch target (use switch_build_target). Use dry_run to preview.
- switch_build_target: Switch the active build target (destructive, long-running: triggers a full reimport + domain reload). Requires confirm=true. Returns immediately; poll switch_build_target_status. [requires target]
- switch_build_target_status: Status of the last target switch: idle | switching | completed (with success + activeBuildTarget).

enabled.description: Whether the scene is enabled in the build list.

outputPath.description: Output path (absolute, or relative to the project root). Defaults to the last/auto path.

profileName.description: Build Profile name to activate before building (Unity 6 only; ignored otherwise).

options.description: BuildOptions names. Omit to get just DetailedBuildReport; supplying any disables that default.

scenes.description: Scene asset paths to build (e.g. Assets/Scenes/Main.unity). Defaults to EditorBuildSettings.

developmentBuild.description: Build a Development Player (enables the debugger/profiler).

allowDebugging.description: Allow script debugging (only effective with developmentBuild=true).

connectWithProfiler.description: Auto-connect the Profiler (only effective with developmentBuild=true).

buildScriptsOnly.description: Build only the scripts (skip data) for faster iteration.

symlinkSources.description: Symlink runtime/plugin sources instead of copying (where supported).

il2CppCodeGeneration.description: IL2CPP code generation for the active target: OptimizeSpeed | OptimizeSize.

settings.description: Fields to change; omitted fields are left unchanged.

tools.name: unity_settings
tools.description:
Project settings (player, quality, graphics, physics, audio, time, input, tags/layers, runtime pipeline): get_* reads, set_* writes (confirm/dry_run).
Actions:
- get_audio_settings: Read project Audio settings (volume, rolloff scale, doppler factor).
- get_graphics_settings: Read GraphicsSettings (default render pipeline).
- get_input_settings: Read the legacy Input Manager axes (names and count).
- get_physics_settings: Read Physics settings (gravity, solver iterations, bounce threshold).
- get_player_settings: Read PlayerSettings (company/product/version, scripting backend, API level).
- get_quality_settings: Read QualitySettings (current level, level names, vSync, anti-aliasing).
- get_runtime_pipeline_settings: Read Pipeline Runtime settings (enableInBuilds, port, requestTimeoutMs, enableAuditLogging, autoStart, maxWorkItemsPerFrame). Reports the settings in effect, falling back to built-in defaults when none have been authored; never creates the settings file.
- get_tags_layers: Read the project's tags and (named) layers.
- get_time_settings: Read Time settings (fixedDeltaTime, maximumDeltaTime, timeScale).
- set_audio_settings: Change project Audio settings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.
- set_graphics_settings: Set the default render pipeline asset. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.
- set_input_settings: Tune a legacy Input Manager axis (sensitivity/gravity/dead) by name. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.
- set_physics_settings: Change Physics settings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.
- set_player_settings: Change PlayerSettings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z. Scripting backend / API level changes trigger a domain reload.
- set_quality_settings: Change QualitySettings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.
- set_runtime_pipeline_settings: Change Pipeline Runtime settings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z. Refused while in Play Mode: the running driver already loaded its own settings, so a change would silently not apply until the next Play session or build. port, requestTimeoutMs, and maxWorkItemsPerFrame are rejected outright if outside the same bounds the Project Settings page enforces.
- set_tags_layers: Add/remove tags and assign user layer names (index 8-31). Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.
- set_time_settings: Change Time settings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.

tools.name: unity_package
tools.description:
Package Manager: list/search/add/remove/resolve and status polling.
Actions:
- package_add: Add a UPM package by name@version, git URL, or 'file:' local path. Async by default (returns in_progress; poll package_status); pass wait=true to block until added. A recompile/domain reload follows — poll recompile_status. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. [requires identifier]
- package_list: List packages by scope: installed (default) | available (registry) | all (both). Returns the full result synchronously — available/all block until the registry query completes.
- package_remove: Remove a UPM package by name. Async by default (returns in_progress; poll package_status); pass wait=true to block until removed. A recompile/domain reload follows — poll recompile_status. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. [requires name]
- package_resolve: Resolve/refresh packages from the manifest (re-fetch and re-link). May trigger a recompile/domain reload — poll recompile_status. Its outcome is recorded for package_status.
- package_search: Search packages available in the registry. Provide a name (e.g. com.unity.foo) or omit to list all. Returns the full result synchronously (blocks until the registry query completes).
- package_status: Status of the last async package operation (add/remove/resolve): idle | in_progress | completed | failed, with the added package, manifest, and any error.

identifier.description: Package to add: 'com.unity.foo@1.2.3', a git URL, or 'file:../Path'.

scope.description: Which packages to list: installed (default) | available | all.

include_indirect.description: Include indirect (transitive) installed dependencies (applies to scope=installed/all).

query.description: Package name to search for. Omit/empty to list all available packages.

tools.name: unity_code
tools.description:
Scripts and code execution: create/attach scripts, recompile (+status), eval C#, run_script, code reload, batch of commands.
Actions:
- attach_script: Add a MonoBehaviour to a GameObject by its (compiled) type name OR by its script asset path. Provide exactly one of 'type' or 'script'. If the type isn't compiled yet, returns a recoverable error: recompile, poll recompile_status, then retry. [requires target]
- batch: Run multiple registered commands in one transactional request. Later ops can reference earlier results with "$<id-or-index>.<jsonPath>" (e.g. "$0.instanceId"; "$$" escapes a literal '$'). transactional=true (default) groups every op into one Undo step and reverts all applied ops if any op fails; commands that mutate outside the Undo system (asset/file/settings writes) are rejected unless transactional=false. on_error=abort|continue (continue forces transactional=false); dry_run validates without mutating; time_budget_ms (default 50000) bounds execution — when exceeded the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back (submit long batches with "job": true). Excludes build, switch_build_target, package_*, editor_play/stop/pause, recompile, eval, eval_file, run_script, menu, open_scene/create_scene, async commands (run_tests/list_tests), runtime-only commands, and nested batch. [requires operations]
- create_script: Create a new C# script (default base class MonoBehaviour) from a template under the authoring root. NOTE: the type does not exist until a recompile completes — to attach it, call recompile, poll recompile_status, then attach_script. [requires name]
- eval: Evaluate C# code dynamically using Roslyn compiler [requires code]
- eval_file: Evaluate C# code read from a .cs file on disk [requires file]
- recompile: Force a script recompile (works while unfocused/minimized). Poll recompile_status for completion.
- recompile_status: Get the status of the last recompile: idle | triggered | compiling | completed | up_to_date.
- reload_file: Compile and apply in-place [CodeReload] edits from a source file [requires filename]
- reload_file_editor_interpreter: Compile in-place [CodeReload] edits and run them through the IlInterpreter VM in this process instead of Assembly.Load (IL2CPP-safe; only a minimal host API + the target type are available) [requires filename]
- reload_file_player_interpreter: Compile a file's (or folder's) [CodeReload] method(s) and push the IL to a connected player (IL2CPP-safe) over PlayerConnection. Folders are walked recursively and pushed once. [requires filename]
- run_script: Compile a project C# file in memory (no domain reload) and execute a named static entry point. The builder-pattern path for bulk construction. Still arbitrary code execution — shares eval's capability gate. [requires file]

target.description: Reference to the GameObject to add the component to (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath).

type.description: Component type name to add, e.g. PlayerController or Game.Player.PlayerController. Must already be compiled. Mutually exclusive with 'script'.

script.description: Script asset path, e.g. 'Assets/Pool/Scripts/CueShooter.cs'. The backing class is resolved via MonoScript.GetClass(), so the class name may differ from the filename. Mutually exclusive with 'type'.

id.description: Optional id for referencing this op's result from a later op ("$<id>.<field>"). Unique within the batch; must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ (not purely numeric, no dots).

command.description: Name of the registered command to run.

params.description: Parameters for the command. String values may reference a prior op's result: "$<id-or-index>.<jsonPath>".

operations.description: Ordered operations to run; each is { id?, command, params }. Max 200.

transactional.description: Group all ops into one Undo step and revert every applied op if any op fails. Default true. Forced false when on_error=continue. Rejects commands whose mutations Undo cannot revert (asset/file/settings writes).

on_error.description: abort (default): stop at the first failing op. continue: run every op, collecting per-op errors (forces transactional=false).

result_fields.description: Optional per-op result projection: map of op id-or-index -> array of result field paths to keep (context economy).

time_budget_ms.description: Cooperative time budget for the whole batch in milliseconds (default 50000, max 3600000). Checked before each op after the first; when exhausted the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back. Use "job": true for long batches.

name.description: Class/file name without extension, e.g. PlayerController. Must be a valid C# identifier.

path.description: Folder (relative to the authoring root; the Assets/ prefix is optional) to write the .cs into. Defaults to the authoring root.

namespace.description: Optional namespace to wrap the class in. Omit for the global namespace.

base_class.description: Base class to derive from. Defaults to MonoBehaviour.

overwrite.description: Overwrite the file if it already exists. Defaults to false (an existing file is an error).

focus.description: If true, bring the Editor to the foreground before compiling. Off by default.

player.description: Target connected player id; -1 = broadcast to all connected players

entry.description: Entry point as Namespace.Type.Method (or Type.Method, or a bare Method name). Default: the single public static method if unambiguous, else a method named Main. Static methods only in v1. Ephemeral mode only (rejected with mode=hotpatch, which never invokes an entry point).

args.description: JSON array of arguments passed to the entry point, coerced to its parameter types: primitives, enum names, string[], and a string/object handle (ObjectRef) for UnityEngine.Object parameters. Ephemeral mode only (rejected with mode=hotpatch).

mode.description: ephemeral (default): compile to an in-memory assembly, run the entry, discard. hotpatch: apply [CodeReload] method replacements to already-loaded types (reload_file semantics).

references.description: Extra assembly name prefixes to reference beyond the auto-resolved set. In the Editor all loaded assemblies are already referenced, so this is effectively a no-op there. Ephemeral mode only; not applied by hotpatch (which delegates to reload_file's own compile).

defines.description: Extra scripting define symbols APPENDED to the project's active editor defines (UNITY_EDITOR etc. are already set) for the compilation's #if directives. Ephemeral mode only; not applied by hotpatch.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Bounds the main-thread dispatcher wait AND, for an async entry point, how long its Task is awaited (on expiry the task keeps running detached).

tools.name: unity_test
tools.description:
Unity Test Runner: list, run (async, poll test_status), cancel.
Actions:
- cancel_tests: Cancel running test execution
- list_tests: List all available tests (EditMode and/or PlayMode) without running them
- run_tests: Execute Unity tests with filtering options
- test_status: Get status of running async test execution

filter.description: Test name filter pattern (case-insensitive partial match)

filter_type.description: Filter type: testName, assembly, category (default: testName)

async_tests.description: Run asynchronously - return immediately, poll /test-status for results

tools.name: unity_editor
tools.description:
Editor state and control: status, play/pause/stop, focus, menu items, selection, search, authoring root, autotick, waits on conditions.
Actions:
- editor_focus: Bring the Unity Editor window to the foreground
- editor_pause: Toggle pause state of Unity Editor play mode
- editor_play: Enter Unity Editor play mode
- editor_status: Get detailed Unity Editor status and state information
- editor_stop: Exit Unity Editor play mode
- get_authoring_root: Get the base folder (under Assets/) that bare authoring paths resolve against.
- get_selection: Read the current Editor selection as structured object identities.
- menu: Execute an Editor menu item by path, or list available items when no path is given
- search: Run a Unity Search query and return structured results. [requires query]
- set_authoring_root: Set the base folder (under Assets/) that bare authoring paths resolve against and are confined to. Use 'Assets' for full project access. [requires root]
- set_autotick: Keep the editor ticking while unfocused by forcing EditorApplication.SignalTick at a throttled rate
- set_selection: Set the Editor selection to the given assets/scene objects.
- wait_cancel: Cancel an async wait started with wait_for (async=true). [requires wait_id]
- wait_for: Wait server-side until a member condition holds, then optionally act in the same frame. Sync waits hold the exec queue (every other command waits behind them, including one the condition may depend on) — keep them short and self-contained; set async=true and poll wait_status for anything else. [requires condition]
- wait_status: Get the status/result of an async wait started with wait_for (async=true). [requires wait_id]

path.description: Menu item path to execute, e.g. "Assets/Reimport All". Omit to list available menu items.

query.description: Unity Search query string, e.g. 't:Material', 'p: my asset', 'h: Main Camera'.

root.description: Project-relative folder under Assets/, e.g. Assets/AgentWork. Use 'Assets' to allow the whole project.

interval_ms.description: Minimum milliseconds between forced ticks. 0 = every update (max rate, pegs a CPU core). Default 16 (~60Hz).

persist.description: Persist this choice to SessionState so it survives a domain reload. Set false for a one-off/expensive setting (e.g. interval_ms=0) that should revert to the last persisted choice (or the default) after the next recompile instead of sticking for the rest of the session.

instance_ids.description: Scene/loaded object instance IDs to select.

member.description: Dotted member path. With no target/findType it is a fully-qualified static path (e.g. "UnityEditor.EditorApplication.isPlaying"); with target/findType it walks instance members (e.g. "State" or "Health.CurrentHealth"). Read-only members only.

target.description: Object handle (instanceId / hierarchyPath / guid / path / globalId) to read instance members from. Omit for a static member path or to use findType.

findType.description: Fully-qualified UnityEngine.Object type name; the member walks from its first loaded instance. Alternative to target.

op.description: Comparison: equals (default) | notEquals | greaterThan | lessThan | contains (strings) | changed (met on first change from the initially observed value; needs no value). changed is for value-like members (primitives/enums/strings); content mutations inside a reference-typed member are not detected.

value.description: Comparison operand, coerced to the member's type (primitive, enum name, or string). Required for every op except 'changed'. equals/notEquals accept an EXPLICIT null (e.g. wait-until-destroyed: a destroyed leaf value observes as null); omitting the key entirely is rejected.

condition.description: Condition to wait for: { member, target?, findType?, op, value }. member is a dotted path (static, or instance under target/findType); op is equals|notEquals|greaterThan|lessThan|contains|changed.

timeout_s.description: Maximum seconds to wait (default 30, clamped to 0-600; must be finite).

poll_interval_ms.description: How often to re-check the condition, in milliseconds (default 100, clamped to 16-5000; must be finite).

view.description: Which view to capture: game (default) or scene.

source.description: Game view only: 'camera' (default) renders a camera and misses Screen Space - Overlay UI; 'screen' captures the composited game view incl. overlay canvases (HUDs), Play Mode only.

save_path.description: Project-relative path to write the PNG (e.g. Screenshots/victory.png).

include_image.description: Also return the PNG inline as base64 (default false: path-only when save_path is set).

capture.description: Capture the game or scene view the moment the condition holds (reuses the capture command internals).

pause.description: Pause play mode on the frame the condition holds (no-op outside play mode).

on_met.description: Follow-up run in the same editor frame the condition first holds: { capture: { view, source, save_path, width, height, include_image }, pause }.

return_history.description: Include the observed value/timestamp samples (a ring buffer of the last 200, so the tail near the transition is kept).

tolerate_missing.description: Treat resolution failures (type/member/instance not found) as condition-not-met and retry until timeout, instead of failing fast. Enables waiting for something to exist (e.g. a spawned object via findType).

async.description: Return a wait_id immediately and evaluate in the background; poll wait_status and cancel with wait_cancel. Use this for long waits and whenever the condition depends on a command you still need to issue — a sync wait blocks it.

tools.name: unity_diagnostics
tools.description:
Console logs/status/clear, performance stats, project audit, eval usage report, game/scene view capture and screenshots, Nexus diagnostics.
Actions:
- audit: Run a Project Auditor static-analysis scan. Returns immediately; poll audit_status until status is 'completed', then read the CSV.
- audit_status: Get the status of the last audit: idle | scanning | completed | failed | interrupted | unavailable.
- capture_game_view: Render the game view to a PNG. source=camera (default) renders a camera and misses Screen Space - Overlay UI; source=screen captures the composited backbuffer incl. overlay canvases (Play Mode only). Returns it inline as base64, unless save_path is set (path-only result; pass include_inline_image=true to get both).
- capture_scene_view: Render the active Scene View to a PNG. Returns it inline as base64, unless save_path is set (path-only result; pass include_inline_image=true to get both).
- clear_console: Clear the captured log buffer and the Unity Editor console.
- console: Get captured Unity console output (Editor or Player; supports tail, level filtering, and follow via a cursor)
- console_status: Console ground truth and buffer counters without pulling entries: compile-failure flag, Editor console counts, and the buffer's retained counts and cursor.
- get_performance_stats: Read render, memory, and frame-timing stats (structured, read-only).
- nexus_capture_game_view: Captures presented Game View pixels including Overlay UI, with JPEG/PNG and optional downscale.
- nexus_group_compile_errors: Analyzes recent console logs, extracts C# compiler errors (CSxxxx), and groups them by root cause file.
- nexus_project_map: Generates a curated high-level project intelligence map for AI agents.
- report_evals: Aggregate local eval-usage telemetry into a ranked report: API fingerprint frequency, one-liner percentage, error rate, and command-coverage suggestions.
- screenshot: Capture the Scene or Game view as a PNG and return its file path

categories.description: Comma-separated issue categories to scan (e.g. Code,ProjectSetting,Texture). Default: all categories.

camera.description: Optional camera name (source=camera only); defaults to Camera.main, else the first enabled camera.

source.description: What to capture: 'camera' (default) renders a camera (misses Screen Space - Overlay UI); 'screen' captures the composited game view incl. overlay canvases (HUDs), Play Mode only.

tail.description: Maximum number of most-recent entries to return

level.description: Minimum severity to include: log | warn | error

since.description: Cursor: only return entries newer than this seq. Use the 'cursor' from a previous response to follow.

since_session.description: Session the 'since' cursor came from: pass the 'session' from a previous response. A cursor from another session is refused and the tail returned with reset=true.

max_dimension.description: Maximum allowed longest edge in pixels (0 for unconstrained).

max_logs.description: Maximum number of recent console log entries to inspect.

top.description: Maximum entries in each ranked list (API fingerprints, and uncovered patterns suggested as commands). Accepted range: 0 or greater; negative values fall back to the default (50).
